shape.rule: YouTube's standard shape is 16:9 horizontal, and square or vertical videos up to 3 minutes count as Shorts.

duration.rule: The maximum upload is 12 hours or 256 GB, whichever is less.
duration.warn_rule: By default, uploads can be up to 15 minutes; verified accounts can upload longer videos.

resolution.rule: YouTube's recommended resolution list includes 720p HD at 1280x720.
resolution.note: lowest HD resolution in YouTube's recommended list

fps.rule: Common frame rates are 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, and 60 fps; other frame rates are also acceptable.

shape.rule: Square or vertical videos up to 3 minutes are categorized as Shorts.

duration.rule: A square or vertical video must be 3 minutes or less to be categorized as a Short.

resolution.rule: Short videos can be uploaded with a maximum resolution of 1080p.

shape.rule: TikTok web uploads must be 720x1280 or higher; this preset reads that portrait size as vertical.
shape.note: the shape rule is read from the published portrait resolution

duration.rule: Videos uploaded in TikTok can be up to 60 minutes long.
duration.warn_rule: Web uploads in creator tools can be up to 30 minutes long.

resolution.rule: Web uploads must have a resolution of 720x1280 or higher.

shape.rule: Reels accept aspect ratios between 9:16 and 1.91:1.

duration.rule: Reel clips can add up to 20 minutes.
duration.warn_rule: Reels over 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences.

resolution.rule: Reels should have a minimum resolution of 720 pixels.

fps.rule: Reels should have a minimum frame rate of 30 fps.
